title: MTGCard
description: Open Magic: The Gathering packs and play with friends in Minecraft!
body:
![MTG Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e0eebe445c41e59c669c9ea7aedc9189f13eb60.png)
MtgCard brings the world of Magic: The Gathering into Minecraft as a fully interactive, in-game experience.

# Features
Open booster packs and collect real MTG cards pulled directly from official Magic: The Gathering sets. Can even store the cards in the Card Database, so that they don't needlessly fill up your chests.
Booster packs can be crafted or found in any loot chest.

If you don't want to always open up booster packs to get the cards, there is a card store that you can buy from. The price on the cards are based on their real value. $1 = 1 diamond
If you don't want the cards to cost diamonds, feel free to go into the config to change it to whatever item you want.

Everything is designed to feel diegetic — cards exist as real items, GUIs are styled like arcane terminals, and displays integrate seamlessly into bases, shops, and multiplayer hubs.

Block features:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Deckbox
  - Store your decks in these 100 slots boxes. They are designed to only hold cards and one slot to hold a bundle for tokens.
  - There are multiple wood variants for this block for decoration purposes.
- Graveyard
  - This block helps keep track of what cards are in the graveyard and exile during a game.
  - Block is designed to look like a crypt for graveyard builds.
- Deck Control
  - If placed between a deckbox and a graveyard, it will help you control your deck library in the deckbox by drawing, milling, and many more features.
  - Designed to be a light source for gardens. Has multiple color variants.
- Health Tracker
  - This will keep track of your health.
  - If in a pod you can have it randomly select who goes first and keeps track of commander damage if playing in the commander format.
- Display Block
  - Will display the health from the health tracker.
  - Also can have it be designed in a way for different looks.
- Card Database
  - Has infinite storage for holding all of the cards that you have collected.
  - If a deckbox is placed next to it, it has the deckbox screen show up beside the Card Database screen for cross comparing.
- Card Store
  - If you don't want to open booster packs all of the time, you can buy them as singles instead.
  - You can drag and drop a text file or a csv file onto the screen and it will load the cards into the cart instead.
  - The cards are based on their real value at that time. $1 = 1 diamond

</details>

# Customizability
There is even a functionality to import your own custom cards into the game using the import command.
```
/mtg custom import
```
Custom cards have a higher chance on showing up in booster packs when being opened unless configured diffeently.

If you don't want the cards to have a value in diamonds, then you can change the item in the configs as well.

# Info
This was designed to make the tcg game feel playable in Minecraft. You can place cards on floors or walls, keep track of your life total on displays, even some of the blocks has some redstone capabilites.

Whether you’re a Magic player, a Minecraft builder, or a server owner looking for a new way to play tabletop-style games in survival, MTG Card Mod turns your world into a living trading card game.

Collect. Display. Play. Build your Magic inside Minecraft.
